name: aibake
description: AiBake - Professional baking recipe management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:middleware: npm run build --prefix middleware && npm run test:watch --prefix middleware
scripts.build: concurrently -n middleware,backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run build --prefix middleware" "npm run build --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:seq: npm run build --prefix middleware && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: concurrently -n middleware,backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run test --prefix middleware" "npm run test --prefix backend" "npm run test --prefix frontend -- --run"
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n middleware,backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run test:watch --prefix middleware" "npm run test:watch --prefix backend" "npm run test --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:test: concurrently -n build,test -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run build:seq" "npm run test"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n middleware,backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run lint --prefix middleware" "npm run lint --prefix backend" "npm run lint --prefix frontend"
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix middleware && npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.type-check: concurrently -n middleware,backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run type-check --prefix middleware" "npm run type-check --prefix backend" "npm run type-check --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix middleware && npm install --prefix frontend
